maddeler.e:
ارتجلا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَلَا (irtajalā) /ir.ta.d͡ʒa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# اُرْتُجِلَا (urtujilā) /ur.tu.d͡ʒi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# اِرْتَجِلَا (irtajilā) /ir.ta.d͡ʒi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
